朝鮮の類似宗教 1935

Chōsen no ruiji shūkyō (Quasi-Religions in Korea), 朝鮮總督府 調査資料 第四十二輯
朝鮮總督府 (Government-General of Chōsen), Keijō, 1935 (昭和10年9月10日); by 村山智順 (Murayama Chijun)

All 145 tables are transcribed — 第一表 to 第四十三表 (many running over several spreads, read in fragments and joined), the small 敎勢 boxes of chapters 2–7, the printed figures of the eight bar-chart plates and the lists with counts in chapters 9–11 — with the printed contents linked to the scan; the prose, the groups' rules and officer lists, the emblems, the dot map and the photographs are not. Every spread was surveyed on contact sheets by Claude Sonnet 5.5, and the tables, all in kanji numerals, were read once by Claude Opus 5.5 (82 missions). The book's printed totals often do not add up (by 1–20 in many year columns, more in a few) and are kept as printed and noted; in 第一表 the print gives 天道敎's 布敎所 and 敎區 the other way round from the group's own table in chapter 2. 56 of some 76,000 figure cells are unreadable (stacked 一/二/三 strokes that no printed total settles) and marked [?].
